title: cFifo2_socmem
summary: 结构子 cFifo2_socmem 的协议摘要，family 为 Fifo1。

semantic_contract.event_behavior: Non-reentrant: the FIFO stage must not accept a new upstream drive until the previous transaction is freed.
semantic_contract.data_behavior: This family primarily communicates through event handshakes.
semantic_contract.completion_behavior: Upstream o_free is only generated after receiving the paired i_free (i_freeNext in staged designs), which indicates the transaction is complete.

backpressure_behavior.blocking_condition: Fifo1 的完成传播尚未细化到更具体的阻塞条件。
